about.title: About
about.intro: Goomu Fulo Wiɗto is an organization dedicated to the preservation, promotion and development of the Fulfulde language.
about.mission: Our mission is to create a comprehensive dictionary of the Fulfulde language, promote its use in education and media, and preserve the cultural heritage of the Fulɓe through their language.
about.history: Founded by a group of linguists, writers and advocates of Fulfulde culture, Goomu Fulo Wiɗto was created to address the urgent need to document and standardize Fulfulde in the digital age.

languageQuestions.title: Language
languageQuestions.intro: Explore frequently asked questions about the Fulfulde language, its grammar, usage and unique features.
languageQuestions.q1: What is the difference between Pulaar and Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a1: Pulaar and Fulfulde refer to the same language, spoken by the Fulɓe (Fula people). Pulaar is the name used primarily in West Africa (Senegal, Mauritania, Guinea), while Fulfulde is the generic term encompassing all dialectal variants across Africa.
languageQuestions.a2: Fulfulde is spoken by approximately 40 to 50 million people across Africa, from Senegal to Sudan. It is one of the most widespread languages on the African continent.
languageQuestions.q3: What alphabet is used to write Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a3: Fulfulde is primarily written in the Latin alphabet with special characters (ɓ, ɗ, ŋ, ƴ, ɲ, ñ). The Arabic alphabet (Ajami) is also traditionally used. Goomu Fulo & Wiɗto uses the standardized Latin alphabet.
languageQuestions.q4: What are noun classes in Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a4: Fulfulde has a unique system of noun classes (about 25) that determine grammatical agreements. Each noun belongs to a class that influences pronouns, adjectives and verb forms. This is one of the most distinctive features of the language.
languageQuestions.q5: How does conjugation work in Fulfulde?
languageQuestions.a5: Conjugation in Fulfulde is rich and complex. Verbs change form according to tense, aspect, voice (active, passive, middle) and subject. The verbal system also includes extensions that modify the meaning of verbs (causative, reciprocal, intensive, etc.).
languageQuestions.a6: Several resources exist: university courses, Fula cultural associations, and online tools like the Goomu Fulo & Wiɗto dictionary. Our site aims to facilitate the learning and preservation of this language.

terminology.title: Fulfulde
terminology.intro: Terminology aims to create and standardize technical and scientific terms in Fulfulde for modern fields of knowledge.
terminology.whyText: For a language to remain alive and relevant, it must be able to express the realities of the modern world. Terminological creation allows Fulfulde to adapt to scientific, technological and administrative domains.
terminology.methodText: Goomu Fulo & Wiɗto follows a rigorous approach to creating new terms: studying existing roots, morphological derivation, adapted borrowing, and validation by speakers.
terminology.domScienceDesc: Terms for mathematics, physics, biology, computer science and natural sciences.
terminology.domSocietyDesc: Legal, administrative and social science vocabulary adapted to Fulfulde.
terminology.domHealthDesc: Medical and health terminology for better communication in healthcare settings.
terminology.domEduDesc: Pedagogical terms to support teaching in the Fulfulde language.
terminology.exploreText: Browse our dictionary to discover specialized terms in each domain.
